security_audit.summary: The single static finding is a false positive caused by Markdown inline code around a documentation path, not shell execution. No prompt injection, data exfiltration, or malicious intent was found in SKILL.md.

static_findings.snippet: - If detailed examples are required, open `resources/implementation-playbook.md`.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 26 uses Markdown inline code to reference a documentation path, not Ruby backtick execution. The skill is prompt-only and contains no executable shell command.

content.value_statement: Java teams need practical guidance for modern language features, Spring Boot, and production performance. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code focused Java architecture, testing, and optimization support.
actual_capabilities: Guides Java 21+ feature usage, including virtual threads, records, sealed classes, and pattern matching.
Advises on Spring Boot 3.x, Spring Security, Spring Data, and Spring Cloud architecture.
Plans JVM performance tuning, garbage collection choices, profiling, and GraalVM native image work.
Designs microservices, event-driven systems, resilience patterns, and cloud-native deployment approaches.
Recommends testing strategies with JUnit 5, Mockito, Spring Boot Test, Testcontainers, and contract tests.
Covers secure coding practices, input validation, secret handling, and OWASP-focused review points.
limitations: It provides guidance and examples, but it does not execute or verify Java projects by itself.
It relies on project context, source files, logs, and constraints supplied by the user.
The referenced implementation playbook is not included in the packaged file structure.
It cannot replace current dependency, compliance, or production security reviews.

use_cases.title: Modernize Java Services
use_cases.description: Plan upgrades to Java 21, Spring Boot 3.x, virtual threads, and current framework conventions.

use_cases.title: Design Enterprise Architectures
use_cases.description: Shape microservices, distributed tracing, resilience, security, and persistence patterns for production systems.

use_cases.title: Improve JVM Performance
use_cases.description: Review throughput, latency, memory, startup time, profiling, benchmarking, and GraalVM deployment options.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Java Task
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me plan this Java 21 task. Explain the best approach, key risks, tests, and verification steps.

prompt_templates.title: Upgrade a Spring Service
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Spring Boot service upgrade to Java 21 and Spring Boot 3.x. Identify required changes, compatibility risks, and testing priorities.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize JVM Performance
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this Java service performance issue. Recommend profiling steps, JVM tuning options, concurrency changes, and benchmark checks.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Production Platform
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a production-ready Java microservices architecture for this domain. Include security, persistence, observability, resilience, deployment, and test strategy.

output_examples.input: I need to migrate a high-traffic Spring service to Java 21.
output_examples.output: A migration plan covering dependency checks, Spring Boot 3.x changes, virtual thread readiness, test coverage, rollout steps, and monitoring signals.

output_examples.input: Our Java API has high latency during peak traffic.
output_examples.output: A performance review plan covering profiling, garbage collection analysis, database query checks, thread model review, benchmarking, and safe tuning experiments.

output_examples.input: We need secure OAuth2 authentication in a Spring application.
output_examples.output: A security design outline covering Spring Security 6 configuration choices, token validation, authorization rules, error handling, tests, and operational controls.

best_practices: Provide the Java version, Spring version, build tool, deployment target, and relevant constraints.
Ask for tests, observability, security, and rollback guidance when changing production Java systems.
Share representative errors, profiling results, or architecture diagrams when asking for optimization help.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for broad Java advice without project goals, constraints, or runtime context.
Do not apply virtual threads or GraalVM only because they are modern features.
Do not skip integration tests, dependency review, or production monitoring for framework upgrades.

faq.question: What Java versions does this skill target?
faq.answer: It focuses on Java 21 and newer, while still supporting migration planning from older Java versions.

faq.question: Can it help with Spring Boot 3.x?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers Spring Boot 3.x, Spring Framework 6, Spring Security 6, Spring Data, and Spring Cloud patterns.

faq.question: Does it write complete applications?
faq.answer: It can help design and draft application pieces, but users must provide requirements and verify generated work.

faq.question: Can it diagnose production performance issues?
faq.answer: It can plan diagnosis and tuning using logs, metrics, profiles, benchmarks, and architecture details supplied by the user.

faq.question: Does it include security guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers Spring Security, validation, injection prevention, secret handling, and OWASP-focused review points.

faq.question: Is this skill safe for automatic marketplace use?
faq.answer: The audited file is prompt-only. The detected command-execution pattern was a Markdown formatting false positive.
